strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.maintHint: Thepha noma iyiphi inkinobho ukuze ubonise incazelo yayo egcwele.
strings.mdKbSmart: • Ukulanda ibhokisi lokhiye elihlakaniphile: ihlola ibhokisi lokhiye lamanje ngokumelene nohlu lokuhoxiswa luka-Google (CRL) bese izama imithombo eminingi ize ithole ibhokisi elingukhiye elivumelekile, elinesipele esizenzakalelayo kanye nokuqalwa kabusha kwezinsizakalo ezingu-Google. Isebenza kukho konke ompompi futhi idinga i-inthanethi (imizuzu engu-1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Ibhokisi lokhiye kunethiwekhi: ilanda ibhokisi lokhiye endaweni yokugcina esemthethweni (GitHub) futhi ililondoloze kokuthi /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Idinga i-inthanethi futhi kuthatha imizuzu engu-1-3. Isetshenziswa uma ukulanda okuhlakaniphile kwehluleka noma lapho ibhokisi lokhiye lishintshwa mathupha.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ukuxilongwa: ihlola amamojula atholakalayo Wokuhlinzeka Ngokhiye Okude, ihlola inguqulo yesitifiketi sokufakazela esingu-TEE, futhi ibonise isimo sethuluzi le-KmInstallKeybox. Akushintshi lutho — ukubuka kwesimo sedivayisi esingenalutho.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine hlola (funda kuphela): ibonisa izinkomba zezinga elingu-Widevine (L1/L3) kusukela ku-dumpsys, ubukhona befayela elingukhiye we-DRM (IDM), kanye nezakhiwo zesistimu ezihlobene. Ayishintshi lutho nhlobo.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP ukulungisa: isebenzisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ilungisa izinkinga zokufakazela uma ukudlula okuzenzakalelayo kwehluleka. Konke ukugijima kuphrinta umugqa ocacile wempumelelo/wokwehluleka.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ukulungisa okungu-RKP okugcwele: kusebenzisa i-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ngokugcwele. Iphatha amakesi aqinile futhi ithatha isikhathi eside. Umphumela ocacile uvela ekugcineni.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Setha kabusha okuthi GMS: kusula idatha ye-Play Store kanye ne-Google (GMS+GSF) futhi iqalise kabusha idivayisi ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ngobufakazi obunenkani kuphela — ayilokothi ithinte izithombe noma amafayela akho.
strings.mdCertify: • Isitifiketi se-Google Play: ihlola RKP isimo sobufakazi sesitifiketi sedivayisi futhi isethe kabusha izici zokufakazela uma kudingeka. Ayithinti idatha yomsebenzisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER ukulungisa: lungisa Google uhlaka lwezinsizakalo (SOTER) izinkinga ezihlobene nobufakazi bedivayisi. Isetshenziselwa amanye amadivayisi athembele ku-SOTER esikhundleni se-Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Faka i-PIF: isebenzisa i-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Isebenzisa izigxivizo zeminwe ezikhethiwe (zendawo/ezithuthukisiwe) futhi ibuyekeze amafayela angu-pif.prop/pif.json. Umphumela ocacile uyavela kulogi.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF hlola: ibonisa isimo senjini efakiwe, amafayela ezigxivizo zeminwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kanye namalogi. Hlola kuphela — ayishintshi lutho.
strings.mdCanary: • Isibuyekezo se-Canary: isebenzisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ilanda ukukhishwa kwakamuva kwe-Canary Engine ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezitifiketi eziyisibopho ezingu-RKP (Februwari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ukuxilongwa kwenjini: ihlola isimo esingu-TrickyStoreOSS (i-pid, amalogi), amafayela ebhokisi elingukhiye (okusebenzayo uma kuqhathaniswa nomsebenzisi), izigxivizo zeminwe zangempela eziqhathaniswa ne-spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP okhiye. Isibonisi sokuxilonga kuphela.
strings.hintKbSlots: Imojula ilawula izikhala zebhokisi lokhiye ezimbili: eyokuqala (engcwele, engakaze isulwe) neyesibili (isipele). Le thebhu ibonisa ukuthi iyiphi i-slot esebenzayo, ishintsha okuthandwayo, noma iphromotha eyesibili ukuya kweyinhloko ngesicelo esisobala — ngezipele kanye nelogi egcwele.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Ukuxilongwa kobuqotho: ihlola ukungenisa kokhiye ongu-TEE, umjovo welabhulali ngaphakathi kwe-keystore2, isimo sokuhoxiswa (CRL), ukufakwa kohlu lokuvikela kanye nesimo RKP. Ukufunda kuphela - akushintshi lutho.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Faka isicelo kabusha ngokuphephile:

• Uhlu lokuvikela lwakhiwe kabusha kusukela kulo lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olufakiwe.
• Isendlalelo sokuhambisana ne-custom-ROM sisetshenziswa kabusha.
• Ibhokisi lokhiye elisebenzayo lisetshenziswa kabusha.
• Google Play#0000000qalwa kabusha6#0000000uqalwa kabusha6#00000uqalwa kabusha ukhiye oyinhloko awuthintwa.

Qhubeka?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Izikhala zebhokisi lokhiye: zibonisa isimo sezikhala eziyinhloko nezesibili futhi ishintsha okuthandwayo phakathi kwazo. Okuyinhloko (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) kuhlala kuvikelwe futhi akusulwa. Ukuphromotha eyesibili kuya kweyinhloko kudinga ukuqinisekiswa okusobala.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Nyusa i-slot yesibili ibe eyinhloko:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml iba okuqukethwe kwe-slot okuyinhloko.
• Eyinhloko yamanje igcinwa njengekhophi yasenqolobaneni ngaphambi kokushintshwa.
• Akukho okususiwe — umsebenzi uyabuyiseleka emuva.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Sula i-slot yesibili:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml izokhishwa.
• Indawo eyinhloko ayithintwa.

Qhubeka?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Ukulandwa kwebhokisi lokhiye elihlakaniphile (okusha ku-v3.17):

• Ihlola ibhokisi lokhiye lamanje ngokumelene nohlu lokuhoxiswa kwe-Google (CRL).
• Izama imithombo eminingi kuze kutholakale ibhokisi lokhiye elihlanzekile.
• Ukwenza isipele ngokuzenzakalelayo + iqala kabusha#00006#5#50000#5 i-inthanethi (1-3 min). Qhubeka?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Landa ibhokisi lokhiye ku-inthanethi:

• Idawuniloda ibhokisi lokhiye elisemthethweni futhi iliqinisekise.
• Ifakwe unomphela (ayizange ibuyiselwe ekuqaliseni).

⚠️ Idinga i-inthanethi (kufika kuminithi elingu-1). Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Ukunikezwa kabusha okungu-RKP okhiye:

• Ayikho idatha noma amafayela ebhokisi lokhiye asusiwe.
• Qalisa kabusha ifoni ngemva kwalokho.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Ukulungisa okugcwele:

• Izilungiselelo kabusha RKP + iqala kabusha Google amasevisi.
• Idivayisi iqalisa kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo (akukho okusulwayo).

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Qala kabusha Google amasevisi:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — qala kabusha kuphela.
• Akukho okusuliwe futhi NGEKE ukhishwe ngemvume.
• Idivayisi iqalisa kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Phoqelela ukunikeza kabusha (Umlingo Obomvu):

• Kumadivayisi aziba ibhokisi lokhiye eliputshuziwe.
• Isebenza noma okhiye bephilile.
• Ayikho idatha esusiwe.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmCertify:
Phoqa Play Store isitifiketi:

• Isula inqolobane Yesitolo kuphela — i-akhawunti yakho ithintwa.
• Qalisa kabusha, bese uvula Isitolo.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER ukulungisa:

• Iqala kabusha isevisi vendor.soter.
• Isula SOTER idatha yeseva kuphela.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Faka izigxivizo zeminwe (PIF):

• Iguqula i-custom.pif.prop futhi iyifake endleleni yenjini.
• Idinga ukuqalisa kabusha ngemva kwalokho.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmCanary:
Buyekeza izigxivizo zeminwe ze-Canary:

• Idawuniloda izigxivizo zeminwe zakamuva ezisemthethweni ze-Canary kusukela ku-Google.
• Ivumelanisa ipheshi yokuvikeleka + iqala kabusha amasevisi angu-Google (akukho ukusula).

⚠️ Idinga i-inthanethi (1-3 min). Qhubeka?
